{"metadata":{"description":"Local GPT-SoVITS TTS for DeepSeek Harness: reads assistant replies aloud with a draggable mascot and one-click installer.","id":"gh:1424183806","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-dania-voice","slug":"xcw520/dsh-dania-voice","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","gpt-sovits","tts"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Local GPT-SoVITS TTS for DeepSeek Harness: reads assistant replies aloud with a draggable mascot and"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" one-click installer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-dania-voice"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Local **GPT-SoVITS** text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness. It reads assistant replies aloud in a
fine"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"-tuned voice, controlled by a small draggable mascot hanging at the top of the interface."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Everything runs on your machine — no audio, no text leaves it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Playback happens in the browser on purpose: the Host process has no audio device, and the voice
shou"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ld come out of **the machine you are actually sitting at**."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"When cleaning, inline code is not dropped — `ops_bash` is spoken as `ops bash`, and long
all-caps wo"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"rds are lowercased so the model reads them as words instead of spelling out
`E X E C U T O R`. Code "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"blocks become a single spoken cue ("there's a code block here")
instead of being read line by line."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Item | Note |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| DSH | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |
| Python | **3.10 – 3.12** (the installer looks for it; it does not instal"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"l Python) |
| GPU | NVIDIA with 8 GB+ VRAM recommended. CPU works but is several times slower. |
| D"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"isk | ~5 GB (PyTorch + base models + voice model) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then open the mascot panel and click **One-click setup**. The installer runs as a separate
process a"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nd reports progress into the same panel:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. creates a Python venv under the install directory
2. installs PyTorch (CUDA build when `nvidia-sm"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"i` is present)
3. installs the inference dependencies
4. downloads GPT-SoVITS source (~50 MB)
5. dow"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"nloads the pretrained base models (~1.6 GB)
6. downloads the voice model and its reference audio (~3"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" the pretrained base models (~1.6 GB)
6. downloads the voice model and its reference audio (~320 MB)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"It is idempotent — if it fails halfway, click again and completed steps are skipped. That matters
be"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"cause step 5 is a 1.6 GB download."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The default install directory is `$DSH_HOME/dania-voice`. Override it with `installDir` if you
want "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"it on another drive."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A mascot hangs at the top centre of the window:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Click** — toggle reading on/off
- **Drag** — move it anywhere; the position is remembered
- **Ri"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ght-click / Shift+click** — open the settings panel
- While reading, the mascot gently bobs"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Panel controls: volume, speed, temperature (lower = steadier, less breathiness), inter-sentence
paus"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"e, plus **repeat last reply** and **say a line** for testing."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Changing speed/temperature applies to the next synthesis; audio is cached by `text + parameters`,
so"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" repeating with the same settings is instant."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Written to `$DSH_HOME/dania-voice/config.json` by the panel. The `config:` block in your profile
pat"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ch works too and is overridden by the panel."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `volume` / `speed` / `temperature` | `1` / `1` / `0.7` | Pl"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ayback and sampling |
| `speakUser` | `false` | Also read your own messages |
| `installDir` | `$DSH"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"_HOME/dania-voice` | Where the engine lives |
| `pythonPath` / `root` / `cacheDir` | derived | Only "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"needed for a hand-made install |
| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:9880` | GPT-SoVITS endpoint |
| `au"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"tostart` | `true` | Start the service when needed |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Short English tokens sound mushy.** A full English sentence comes out fine — transcribing a
synthe"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"sised sentence back gives an almost exact match. But short identifiers or ones with digits
(`ops bas"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"h`, `cut2`, `sha1`) come out close to Chinese syllables, as if the voice were mumbling.
That is a mi"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"smatch between the voice model and English phonemes, not something the plugin can
fix. Inline code i"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"s still turned into speakable English; longer identifiers fare better than short ones."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**A segment is capped at 90 characters.** The server's generation loop is hard-coded to 1500
semanti"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"c tokens (~30 s); past that it stops silently and truncates. With 147 characters in one
unsegmented "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"request, a whole sentence went missing in testing. 90 leaves about 30% headroom, at
the cost of more"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" pauses between segments."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**URLs and tables are not spoken.** A URL reads as a string of letters nobody can follow, and a
tabl"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"e reads as a list of numbers; both are dropped. The dropped spot is closed with a full stop so
the n"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"eighbouring sentences are not glued together."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **Mascot shows a red border** — the plugin's routes are not answering; check that the plugin is en"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"abled.
- **"Not installed yet"** — click one-click setup, or check `$DSH_HOME/dania-voice/install.lo"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"g`.
- **No sound but the panel says ready** — the browser blocked autoplay; click the mascot once.
-"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" **Slow first line** — the model takes 20–40 s to load into VRAM; later lines take 1–3 s."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Credits"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"- GPT-SoVITS by RVC-Boss — MIT.
- Dania voice model by villia on ModelScope.
The installer downloads"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" it from the original repository; it is **not** redistributed here.

material under the publisher's third-party "},{"id":"p35s4","text":"). Background art uses official promotional
material under the publisher's third-party usage policy."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"This is a fan project. Wuthering Waves and its characters belong to Kuro Games."}],"truncated":false}
